labels.look: Dark navy, small mono text in three columns: About the Website, About the Foundry, Links (buy, trials, specimen PDF)
labels.ux: Links to buy, trial, PDF and socials
labels.learn: Name the tools and fonts used to build the site (Coldtype, MD IO) and state 'no cookies': transparency as tone

labels.variantDefinition: A thin footer of one or two lines: copyright and designer credit, maybe a logo, a few links or one social icon; no columns
labels.look: Charcoal strip, centred X icon over one line of copyright and 'Designed by' credit
labels.ux: One social link and designer link
labels.learn: When the specimen is the statement, a one-line footer avoids competing with it

labels.look: White, small foundry badge logo left, five navy text links right, two-line copyright and 'Brought to you by'
labels.ux: Links to Fonts, Store, Blog, Contact, About
labels.learn: A 'brought to you by X and friends' credit line keeps a corporate footer personal

labels.variantDefinition: Tile repeats a section already captured (fullpage scroll looping back, fixed layer, snap reset); not a distinct component instance
labels.look: Same frame as the hero: white 'INFINI' on black, credits box and Download button; fullpage capture looped every 20 tiles
labels.learn: Wheel-driven fullpage sites can loop; dedupe captures before counting components

labels.variantDefinition: Full-screen animated or generative type scenes (falling letters, liquid, drawing-on) that advance by scroll or time, showing the font in motion beyond the hero
labels.look: Black canvas, white rounded sans capitals scattered at the top, a 'B' dripping into a white fill at the bottom
labels.ux: Wheel/time advances canvas scenes; no controls
labels.learn: Build the font as code so letters can fall, melt and pile up: the type itself becomes the animation engine

labels.look: Black canvas, loose white capitals (K, H, C, W, Y, J, O) tumbling, white fill rising from the bottom
labels.ux: Wheel/time advances canvas scenes; no controls
labels.learn: Letters as physical bodies make a geometric sans feel soft and characterful

labels.look: Identical hero frame again: 'INFINI' wordmark, credits box, Download button; second loop of the fullpage capture
labels.learn: Same as #20: exclude looped repeats from pattern counts
